subject: UefiCpuPkg: Consume Public Page Table Definitions
reasons: This is the consumer side of a header move refactor (paired with 530efa6742): removes private type definitions from CpuPageTable.h and adds an #include of the new public header
The change is a large deletion of type definitions (moved to MdePkg) plus a single #include addition — not a transformation of call sites or API usage
Header reorganization / definition migration is not suitable for Coccinelle, which works on C expression/statement patterns, not preprocessor-level structural moves
